assumptions: Serial processing; camera, processing and display caps bound delivered FPS.
Additional costs are hypothetical constants, not observed webcam overhead.
No unbounded frame backlog; estimates do not prove the current application implements latest-frame dropping.
Camera supplies requested 30/60 FPS; display is not a lower bottleneck.
No network transport. No conversion factor for RTX 5060 Laptop.
limitations: Adding a constant to measured p95 is a scenario, not measured joint p95.
Frame acquisition phase, exposure, buffering, scheduling and presentation delay are not estimated as end-to-end latency.
Capture could overlap inference, or block it; actual application scheduling may differ.
Tracker complexity and CPU/GPU contention can change runtime.
